text:
Maya Chen: Heads up — canary with AWQ + act-quant + group-size=64 is producing repeating tokens / decode loops on a couple of long-context prompts. Saw 2 distinct failure cases in the last hour.

Dmitri Kozlov: Which model and runner build?

Maya Chen: gpt-neox-20b-open-redwood @ v3.2.1, awq runtime build awq-0.9.3, canary tag: canary/awq-group64-actq.

Olivia Park: Any logs or minimal repro?

Maya Chen: Paste of the tail of the decode log:

```\n[2026-03-20T14:12:03Z] request_id=0x7f9ca3e4 decode_step=462 token=1334 repeat_count=18 latency_ms=1234\n[2026-03-20T14:12:03Z] request_id=0x7f9ca3e4 decode_step=463 token=1334 repeat_count=19\n[2026-03-20T14:12:03Z] request_id=0x7f9ca3e4 decode_step=464 token=1334 repeat_count=20\nWARNING: high repeat rate, consider act-quant fallback\n```

Maya Chen: Happens only when context > 2048 and model is served with group-size >= 48 and act-quant enabled. Small-context prompts look fine.

EVAL-BOT: Quick eval on the failing prompt set (n=20):
- baseline fp16: repeat_rate=0.0, perplexity=18.4
- awq group=64 act-quant=on: repeat_rate=18%, perplexity_tail=29.1
- awq group=64 act-quant=off: repeat_rate=2%, perplexity_tail=19.2
- awq group=16 act-quant=on: repeat_rate=4%, perplexity_tail=20.3

Ian Morales: Hm. That pattern smells like KV cache misalignment when group packing crosses sequence boundaries. Act-quant changes activation ranges; combined with large group packing it may underflow/overflow some accumulator and shift logits.

Dmitri Kozlov: Could also be a bug in the group batching code path — when group-size > 32 we take a different kernel and do packed KV slices. If act-quant modifies scaling per-group we might not be applying the same inverse scaling on the cached KV.

Olivia Park: Offline eval didn't catch this?

Maya Chen: Offline tests (our standard short/medium contexts) passed. This repro requires: longer prefix + >1 sequence packed in a single group. Our offline harness didn't create that packing distribution.

Dmitri Kozlov: Short mitigation: disable act-quant in canary (AWQ_ACT_QUANT=false) or cap group-size to 16 for canary. I can push a rollback patch to the runner in 10m.

Maya Chen: I'll do a targeted canary rollback now. Also capturing the failing request_id and payload for repro: request_id=0x7f9ca3e4, prompt hash b2a9e3.

deploy-bot: ALERT — canary canary/awq-group64-actq: 3/5 hosts returning repeat-rate > 10%, automatic rollback scheduled in 5m :rotating_light:

Olivia Park: Curious: offline NLL diffs were tiny (0.02) but live tail perplexity jumped. That suggests the failure only emerges under the packing+streaming path.

Ian Morales: Action items: 1) roll canary; 2) add runtime guard: if group-size >= 32 and act-quant enabled, force act-quant=off or reduce group-size to min(group-size,32) for now; 3) add a short test in our regression harness that simulates multi-sequence packing across group boundaries; 4) create a reproducer script.

Dmitri Kozlov: I'll open the PR with runtime guard + a unit test that replays the failing packed sequence. Will tag @Maya for repro artifacts.

EVAL-BOT: ablation results (after quick runs):
- group=64, actq=on: repeat_rate=18% (20/110 cases), mean_tail_perp=29.1
- group=64, actq=off: repeat_rate=2% (3/110), mean_tail_perp=19.2
- group=32, actq=on: repeat_rate=7% (8/110), mean_tail_perp=21.7
- group=16, actq=on: repeat_rate=1% (1/110), mean_tail_perp=19.9

Maya Chen: OK rolling the canary rollback now. Will run the focused packed-sequence harness and upload logs to the ticket.

Olivia Park: Please also capture memory and CUDA kernel selection traces — might help confirm the kernel-change hypothesis.

Maya Chen: Will attach nvprof traces + runner trace. Opening postmortem ticket: PR-#4578 for rollback guard + tests.

Dmitri Kozlov: After rollback lands and tests added, we should add a warning to the model catalog: "AWQ act-quant + group-size > 32 may be unstable for long-packed contexts until fixed".

Maya Chen: Good. Filing the catalog advisory under model card and pinging CS.

EVAL-BOT: Follow-up after rollback: canary repeat_rate dropped to 0.5% and latency returned to baseline.

Maya Chen: Thanks everyone. I'll post the reproducer + exact commands in the PR and assign owners. :thumbsup:

Dmitri Kozlov: Thanks — digging into kernel path now. :eyes:
